description: Synthetic golden set for Document Intelligence v2 evaluation (tasks T0.1, T2.10). Four representative document types with 120 answerable questions annotated with expected page, figure and table-cell answers, 24 unanswerable (abstain) questions, plus ground-truth extraction content (table cells, figure labels, BPMN nodes/edges) for the extraction-quality metrics. Content is synthetic and contains no confidential material.

documents.title: Anforderungsspezifikation (synthetisch)

documents.title: Prozessdokumentation mit BPMN (synthetisch)
documents.note: Synthetic process manual embedding BPMN diagrams for application intake and objections.

documents.title: Maskenhandbuch (synthetisch)
documents.note: Synthetic screen manual with UI-mask screenshots and labelled fields.

documents.title: Plansatz Neubau (synthetisch)
documents.note: Synthetic plan set: large-format technical drawings with title blocks and legends.
